Plan B
---------
Every step should be possible manually, so that if the plugin fails, the user can still complete the process.

- Step 0: Setup
  > Create docs per class.
- Step 1: Update word documents for group classes.
  > Update les data from dko3.
    > how? Plugin can't do this.
    > use google cloud functions to pull data from dko3 and update word documents.
      > dko3 cloud interop/rpc:
        > dko3 polls getCommandFor("dko3");
        > dko3 calls setReply(commandId, ...);
      > c# polls getReply(commandId) and updates word documents.

  !! Alternative: manually update the word documents.
  > Also, this step may not be needed if the documents are already up-to-date.

- Step 2: Send to classes.
  > poll dko3 for emails for the class
  > paste content of document into outlook email
  
  !! Alternative: manually copy emails from dko3 to outlook.
